claims.claim_text: Volkswagen Group of America Investments (VGA) has invested over $300 million in QuantumScape since 2012 and has established a 50-50 joint venture (QSV / QS-1) with QuantumScape to industrially produce solid-state batteries.
claims.source_quote: Since 2012, we have developed a strong partnership with Volkswagen Group of America Investments, LLC ('VGA') and certain of its affiliates (together with VGA, 'Volkswagen'). ... Over the last ten years Volkswagen has invested more than $300 million in us and has established a 50-50 joint venture ('JV') with us to enable an industrial level of production of our solid-state batteries.
claims.subject: Volkswagen Group of America Investments / Volkswagen AG
claims.extraction_notes: VW is a foreign filer (German) and does NOT file 10-K with EDGAR. Counterparty corroboration via EDGAR is structurally weak for VW. We measure how many US filers mention QuantumScape (external validation), which is a soft cohort-mention proxy. A full VW 20-F is unavailable here. Acknowledge UNVERIFIABLE for direct VW counterparty disclosure per Layer 3 Rule 7 footnote (most major OEMs are foreign filers).

claims.claim_text: Since 2021 QuantumScape has signed customer sampling agreements with a number of additional OEMs (top-ten by global revenue plus premium/luxury carmakers) to test and validate its solid-state cells with the goal of eventual serial-production inclusion.
claims.source_quote: Since 2021, we have signed customer sampling agreements with a number of other OEMs, ranging from top ten manufacturers by global revenue to premium performance and luxury carmakers, to collaborate with us in the testing and validation of our solid-state battery cells with the goal of providing such cells to the OEM for inclusion into pre-production prototype vehicles and ultimately into serial production vehicles.
claims.subject: QuantumScape
claims.extraction_notes: Claim is intentionally vague (no OEM names). Use external-validation EDGAR fulltext count as a weak corroborator: how many other SEC filers mention 'QuantumScape' in 10-K/20-F since 2021. Most counterparties (VW, BMW, Mercedes, Hyundai, Toyota, Honda) are foreign filers — Layer 3 Rule 7 warns EDGAR coverage is partial. Calibration Heuristic 3: sampling agreement is an A-sample-stage milestone, NOT a series-production commitment.

claims.claim_text: In 2022 QuantumScape shipped its first 24-layer A0 prototype solid-state battery cells to multiple automotive OEMs for testing.
claims.source_quote: We have demonstrated capabilities of our solid-state electrolyte-separator and battery technology in single-layer and multilayer cell cycling data, and in 2022, shipped our first 24-layer A0 prototype battery cells to multiple automotive OEMs for testing.
claims.subject: QuantumScape
claims.extraction_notes: Shipment of unbranded prototype cells to unnamed OEMs has no external registry analog. Battery-stage gating (A0 = earliest A-sample) is a self-reported R&D milestone. No NHTSA / EPA / patent / contract registry observes it. Calibration Heuristic 3 (planned vs operational): A0 is pre-A-sample — many steps before SOP. Acknowledge structurally UNVERIFIABLE.

claims.claim_text: QuantumScape's pre-pilot manufacturing line QS-0 is located in San Jose, California, and the company is headquartered there.
claims.source_quote: We are headquartered in San Jose, California. Our facilities, which are primarily in San Jose, California include various leased properties for our offices and engineering, research and development, and pre-pilot manufacturing activities.
claims.subject: QuantumScape
claims.extraction_notes: A pre-pilot battery R&D / manufacturing line in California should plausibly trigger EPA FRS registration (hazardous-waste handling, chemical permits). Absence is suggestive but not definitive — battery R&D handling small quantities of solvents/lithium may stay under FRS thresholds. Treat absence as weak signal, not hard contradiction.

claims.claim_text: QuantumScape holds a substantial portfolio of patents covering its solid-state lithium-metal battery technology (proprietary ceramic electrolyte-separator, anode-free architecture, manufacturing processes).
claims.source_quote: We have spent over a decade developing a proprietary solid-state battery technology to meet this challenge. ... Our architecture depends on our proprietary solid-state ceramic electrolyte-separator which we plan to manufacture ourselves. ... We are developing a subsequent, proprietary higher-volume separator manufacturing process that seeks to further reduce cost, increase throughput, and improve quality.
claims.subject: QuantumScape
claims.extraction_notes: Filing claims proprietary IP for over a decade. USPTO ODP grants by assignee 'QuantumScape' is the canonical adjudicator. n_granted is the comparable metric. Bucket categorization tests whether grants are concentrated in claimed tech areas (ceramic separator, anode-free, manufacturing).

claims.claim_text: QuantumScape is a development-stage / pre-revenue company that has incurred ~$2.9 billion accumulated deficit through Dec 31 2023 and net loss of ~$479M for FY2023, with ~$1.1B cash & marketable securities expected to fund operations into the second half of 2026.
claims.source_quote: We are a development-stage company with no revenue to date, have incurred a net loss from operations of approximately $479.0 million for the year ended December 31, 2023, and an accumulated deficit of approximately $2.9 billion from our inception through December 31, 2023. ... As of December 31, 2023 and December 31, 2022, our principal sources of liquidity were our cash and cash equivalents and marketable securities in the amount of approximately $1.1 billion for both periods. ... Based on our current business plan, we believe that our cash resources will last into the second half of 2026.
claims.subject: QuantumScape
claims.object_value: ~$1.1B cash; runway into H2 2026; $479M FY2023 loss; $2.9B accum deficit
claims.extraction_notes: Balance-sheet figures are internal-accounting items audited by E&Y. No external registry adjudicates the cash balance — these are GAAP statements. Forward runway is a forecast (management). Treat as INTERNAL/AUDITED, not externally adjudicatable. (Could be partially cross-checked via later 10-Q filings, but those are post-cutoff for this run if dated >2024-05-17; the 10-Q for Q1-2024 filed in late April/early May could be in-window but is not the focus of this Phase-1 plan.)

claims.claim_text: On Feb 8, 2024 QuantumScape's Board appointed Dr. Siva Sivaram as CEO effective Feb 15, 2024, with Mr. Singh continuing as Chairman.
claims.source_quote: On February 8, 2024, the Board of Directors (the 'Board') of the Company appointed Dr. Siva Sivaram, as the Company's Chief Executive Officer ('CEO') and as a member of the Board, effective February 15, 2024. Mr. Singh will be continuing in his capacity as Chairman of the Board.
claims.subject: QuantumScape
claims.extraction_notes: CEO change should be disclosed via Item 5.02 8-K. List of 8-Ks in the Feb-2024 window adjudicates whether the formal disclosure was filed. Treat presence of 8-K as supporting; absence as contradiction. (Connector returns count + accessions; downstream phase can inspect.)

claims.claim_text: QuantumScape's planned QS-1 factory (operated by the 50-50 QSV joint venture with Volkswagen) plus its QS-1 Expansion would produce battery cells representing less than 2.3% of Volkswagen's 2023 total vehicle production, assuming a 100 kWh pack.
claims.source_quote: QS-1, to be built and run by QSV, our joint venture entity with Volkswagen, and its subsequent QS-1 Expansion, would represent a small fraction of Volkswagen's demand for batteries and implies vehicle volumes under 2.3% of Volkswagen's total production in 2023, assuming a 100kWh battery pack size.
claims.subject: QSV Operations LLC (QuantumScape/VW JV)
claims.object_value: QS-1; vehicle volumes < 2.3% of VW 2023 production

proposed_connector.name: sec_filings.fetch_filing_text
proposed_connector.description: Retrieve the full text of a specific filing (accession) for a given CIK so downstream scoring can search for joint-venture or supply commitments by Volkswagen, BMW, etc. in their 20-F / 6-K filings. Complements edgar_fts (which only returns hit counts) by enabling text-level confirmation that a counterparty NAMES the company in a series-production context (vs. only mentioning as a research investment).
proposed_connector.rationale: QS-1 SOP timing depends on Volkswagen's actual capex commitment. VW is a foreign filer (no 10-K); its 20-F (filed via VLKAY ADR sponsor) or 6-K may or may not name QuantumScape. We need filing text, not just hit counts, to confirm whether VW disclosed QS-1 as a committed production line or only as a research partnership. Today's edgar_fts returns counts only.
proposed_connector.completeness: SEC EDGAR filers only (covers US-listed ADRs / 20-F filers; pure German DAX listings via XETRA are NOT covered).

claims.extraction_notes: QS-1 + Expansion is a forward-looking production-volume claim contingent on (a) QSV factory construction (Salzgitter or similar — not disclosed here), (b) Volkswagen committing series-production volume. Volkswagen is a foreign filer with limited EDGAR coverage. The catalog's edgar_fts gives hit counts but not text; counterparty corroboration of a 'series production' commitment requires reading VW's 20-F/6-K text. Calibration Heuristic 3 + Layer 3 Rule 7 both apply: this is the central JDA-vs-SOP conflation watch.
